acceptanceCriteria: The stale entry is removed from .corvint/unbounded-readers.json
unbounded-readers-check either fails on stale entries or the decision to keep it advisory is recorded with a test
body: Running the charter doc gates (unbounded-readers-check) on lane cem-1021d (#1440, base ae3b418152fe4c42f52ac7cfdc16ecc12159607e) prints a note that .corvint/unbounded-readers.json lists script/pre-push-windows-vet_test.sh as a stale entry. The gate passes anyway, so stale allowlist entries accumulate silently. Expected: remove the stale entry, and decide whether stale entries should fail the check.

completion.reason: Delivered on main ef2a01db52d5436c262725d136060c9eb95e8580 via batch beamfall/corvint#1464 (lane #1445); CI green on that commit (runs 39675360530,39677108995). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 8dccb1a2d8ffd8d2657c40a6373a952a1ef229cfaeb6c71171666a2d38ea890d.

title: Stale unbounded-readers allowlist entry script/pre-push-windows-vet_test.sh is reported but not failed
